messages:
maria: quick design pass on the playground streaming UI. three frictions: stop vs pause semantics unclear, token counter is visually noisy during streams, and prompt-library peek pushes the stream out of view. figma: https://figma.com/file/playground-stream-updates
sam: which two should we tackle for beta?
maria: 1) make stop/pause behavior explicit with clear copy + undo pattern. 2) reduce token counter prominence by default.
alex: dev note: stop currently hard-cancels, pause resumes. i can wire distinct actions but need final copy and a small state diagram. also recommend debouncing token updates to 1s to avoid render jank.
aria: a11y: set the stream container aria-live="polite" and ensure the token counter is NOT a live region. stop must have an accessible name explaining it discards partial results.
maria: copy option: short labels "Stop" (tooltip: "Stops and discards current output") and "Pause" (tooltip: "Pause output; resume later"). tooltips carry extra detail.
sam: agree on short labels + tooltips. we'll A/B explicit labels later.
alex: for destructive Stop, avoid modal on mobile. propose an undo toast "Generation stopped — Undo" with 5s. log undo events.
aria: toast should receive focus and be announced to screen readers; undo must be keyboard accessible.
maria: token counter placement: default inline below prompt (low density) with a user setting to enable a floating pill for power users.
sam: default low-density + a toggle. we'll track adoption.
alex: i'll implement toggles + debounce + undo toast.
maria: prompt library peek: mock currently scrolls conversation. suggestion: split-pane on desktop, overlay on narrow screens so stream controls stay visible.
alex: implement split >=1024px, overlay below that.
deploy-bot: branch created: playground/stream-ux-clarity. CI green.
maria: i'll update figma and add copy variants. assigning: @alex impl toggles+undo+debounce, @aria a11y checklist, @sam metrics dashboard.
sam: i'll add analytics events and slices. ETA next week.
aria: i'll run axe + NVDA tests when branch is up.
maria: thanks team 2 small clarity improvements should help a lot. :sparkles:
